name: Flood
meaning: fill an area with water; the ground turns Wet
why: Water's defining verb; the pool is the bruiser's floor for Crushes.

name: Drain
meaning: empty the water from an area or a target, and draw it in
why: Draws the Soaked to your fists and pays essence back.

name: Ebb
why: The bruiser's reach is a pull: Riptide Lash.

name: Soak
why: Sets up throws (Soaked x1.5, Waterlogged one class lighter).

name: Dry
meaning: pull the water out of a body: damage by how wet it is
why: The heavy payoff on a Soaked body.

name: Heave
meaning: lift a body bodily and throw it
why: Was Float ("buoyancy: lift, lighten, walk on water"). Buoyancy is a caster's lift; the bruiser lifts a body and throws it. Same id, role (link) and draw (-0.5: it gives outward), so its bonds are unchanged. Effect was 'shove +1; poise x0.8'.

name: Drown
meaning: water in the lungs: no casting, no calls for help, damage over time
why: Kept: hold it under, then heave it - the bruiser's grapple. Opposite renamed (Float -> Heave): thrown out of the water against held under it.

name: Splash
meaning: burst outward on contact, spraying those near
why: Backwash: the blow lands on you and bursts back.

name: Seep
meaning: soak in slowly, getting behind shields and armour
why: The bruiser's answer to shields and heavy armour.

name: Wave
meaning: a rolling wall of water that carries what it meets
why: Meaning widened to carry what it meets (Sweep's verb, Sweep is dropped). Opposite changed from Slack (dropped) to Settle: the wave carries, Settle drops what it carried. Role and draw kept.

name: Settle
meaning: the water goes still, and what it carries sinks and stays
why: Kept as Water's only Frame (with Sweep and Slack gone it is the one four-bond rune, so water words can still be held together). Opposite changed from Sweep (dropped) to Wave.

name: Gush
why: A held jet is a caster's verb (Pressure Jet). 16 runes had to come to 12.

name: Drip
meaning: a slow steady trickle that wears and lingers
why: Goes with its opposite; slow wear at range is not a bruiser's.

name: Sweep
meaning: a current that carries things along
why: Its verb (carry along) is folded into Wave; Sluice Step moves to Wave. Taken up by Ice as Floe (drifting ice).

name: Slack
meaning: the still moment at the turn of the tide: everything pauses, reflux eases
why: Stillness is Ice's half from Dark; Ice takes it up as Stasis, whose target comes out Stilled (Slack Water's status).
